articleTitle: HVDC Overhead Line Insulators Selection and Design Update Features
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: The increasing number of HVDC projects has raised new interest in the design of components used in various materials dedicated to DC applications. For example, the unidirectional electric field in a dielectric subjected to a DC voltage generates specific stress conditions resulting in unique features making up the design of insulators. Likewise, the impact of polarization in the environment near a DC line requires special attention for airborne contamination which modifies the ability of a string of insulators to withstand the operating voltage under any circumstances. This paper will review the main features of DC overhead line insulators with specific details related to the various technologies available. Contamination aspects will also be discussed including the latest developments in IEC 60815 [1] as well as new mitigation methods for severe contamination conditions.

articleTitle: Comparison of Locational Marginal Price Calculation Using Five DCOPF Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This paper provides the way to calculate Locational Marginal Prices (LMP) through five Direct Current Optimal Power Flow (DCOPF) algorithms. Two of the five algorithms do not consider system losses, the rest of them obtain the LMP considering the losses through factors which offset, linearize and distribute them in the system. The five algorithms were implemented in a three-bus test system to make a comparison of the results obtained, such as generation dispatch, system losses and PMLs. The comparison is presented under changes in the reference bus.

articleTitle: A Grid Side Converter for Controlling the Injection of Energy into the Grid in a Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: In this paper it is presented the design of the control system of the grid side converter of a back to back configuration. This converter is used for controlling the active and the reactive energy injected into the grid, which is generated by a doubly feed induction generator based wind energy conversion system. Throughout the paper four Proportional Integral (PI) controllers are designed, all these PI controllers are based on vector control theory. An anti-windup strategy, based on a two degrees of freedom controller, is implemented in order to charge the DC link capacitor for the first time. Simulations are carried out using MATLAB/Simulink, where the control system stability and performance of the converter are evaluated. Finally, the results so obtained are analyzed and discuss.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Energy, LED Technology and Energy Efficiency in the ITSAO
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This article presents the works carried out at the Institute of Technology of Acatlán de Osorio (ITSAO), Puebla, Mexico, related to the use and installation of photovoltaic systems; the use of LED technology and the existing contribution in the implementation of the Integral Management System (SGI). Mainly for the Operational Control of Electric Power through the norm ISO 14001: 2004 that is applicable to all the activities, processes, products and services of the ITSAO that consume electrical energy. The behavior of the electricity consumption of the whole institution is analyzed by monitoring the monthly electric bills comparing them with the previous year, a comparison of the energy consumption of lamps with fluorescent tubes and LED lamps that are being installed is shown. It also performs an analysis of the installation of a photovoltaic system with a production of 2.2 kW-h/day.

articleTitle: Determination of the production profile of incinerable waste for the city of Bucaramanga and its energy capacity
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This paper shows the results of the mathematical model that describes the behavior of the amount of incinerable solid waste that has occurred in the city of Bucaramanga and the metropolitan area during the last years. This was done by plotting the points of the record and making use of the minimum square numerical method. Subsequently, the data was projected with series of Fourier and thus got the points of the amount of incinerable waste that will be produced in the next six years in Bucaramanga, which average will be 1,478x109 Kg/month. These methods let calculate additionally the energy capacity base on the amount and calorific value which could be exploited if they are treated in an incineration system. The energy capacity of the waste will be 2,622 thermal MW/day, 1,573 MW electric/day and 1,049 MW would be daily lost based on the typical energy distribution of a system of cogeneration.

articleTitle: Legacy Financial Transmission Rights and their Function and Role they Play during the Financial Transmission Rights Auction
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: The Financial Transmission Rights Market is a mechanism used by the Market Participant for hedging against the Day Ahead Market energy price differences across a Path caused by the congestion cost charges that affects the Local Marginal Price. This paper delves into the beginning and creation of the Mexican Market of Financial Transmission Rights, FTR main characteristics, considerations relating to the assignment of the Legacy FTRs and the current situation of the Financial Transmission Rights Market, this is directly connected to the Mexican Wholesale Electricity Market.

articleTitle: Study for the selection of the optimal method for managing LED arrays, part II programming
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This paper has been divided into two parts, the first part presents several methods of managing LED arrays with their circuits, to present text or variables, the methods are based on a microchip microcontroller, which handles rows and columns of the matrices, which can be of 8 rows by 8 columns (8x8), up to 8x48, as well as the handling of 16x16 up to 16x32, there is direct management from microcontroller, as well as support circuits to reduce the waiting time of the microcontroller. This second part presents the programming of the microcontroller that is done in the PIC-C compiler of ccsC, as well as a program in Java for the generation of characters for the presentation of texts.

articleTitle: Revenue Adequacy Analysis in Financial Transmission Rights Market
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: One of the main problems facing this assignment is the one that arises from carrying out the auction with a present model of the Day Ahead Market for a future assignment and given that there are variables that cannot be foreseen (outages, deterioration, etc.) it is difficult to guarantee the constancy of models, leading to a financial problem known as Revenue Adequacy. In this document, it is described the Revenue Adequacy problematic in the electricity market and some aspects that were taken into consideration in the FTR market implementation.

articleTitle: Micro Processor Based Bus Protection System Using IEC 61850 Process Bus (9-2) Sampled Values
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: A novel, phase segregated bus differential protection scheme, which utilizes independent multi-principle advanced protection algorithms, such as, differential percent slope, delta phase directional comparison, rate of change of differential (ROCOD) currents, delta phase directional comparison on zero sequence current differential, fast CT saturation detection, second harmonic blocking and a check zone to secure the electrical bus bars up to three zones (two main and one transfer bus) will be discussed. The proposed microprocessor based bus protection scheme has the ability to measure the conventional CT currents within the protection unit, and will share / distribute the corresponding sampled values using IEC 61850, 9-2 technique, acting as Merging Unit, with other protection units in the system to perform the overall differential protection. Each protection unit therefore acts as a processing (subscribing sampled values) and as well as a Merging Unit (publishing sampled values). The scheme can be scaled to support up to 24 bays (24 sets of three phase CT current inputs) and a three phase PT voltage input by means of 4 individual relay protection units (6 sets of three phase CT current Inputs per relay) working together as one protection scheme, in a very compact electrical panel (4x3U rack units). For time synchronization, additional inputs, and outputs, an I/O unit is used to collect breaker status, isolator status, and any other inputs into the bus protection scheme.

articleTitle: Procedure for Commissioning and Start-Up of Power Plants and Load Centers in the Wholesale Electric Market
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This paper presents a procedure for commissioning and start-up of Power Plants and Load Centers in the National Transmission Network and General Distribution Network in the electrical power system. On February 9, 2018, the Ministry of Energy ("SENER") published in the Official Journal of the Federation, the “Manual for Interconnection of Power Plants and Connection of Load Centers" (Manual para la Interconexión de Centrales Eléctricas y Conexión de Centros de Carga). This Manual establishes the procedures applicable to the National Energy Control Center ("CENACE") for the interconnection and connection applications in different modalities, as well as the procedures for the interconnection of power plants and the connection of load centers to the National Transmission Network and the General Distribution Network. It also presents a procedure to determine the infrastructure studies and it finishes with the criteria and mechanisms to establish the refund of financial guaranties, as well as, the execution process for interconnection and connection agreements. However, this Manual does not mention activities for commissioning and startup of Power Plants and Load Centers. Therefore, this paper aims to cover this loophole in the legislation, by proposing a procedure that includes all activities needed to commission and start-up power plants and load centers in the electricity Market, from the assignation of the official code name to the reimbursement of the financial guarantees to the market participant candidate. Currently, CENACE is creating a Manual for commissioning and start-up for the interconnection of Power Plants and the connection of Load Centers in the National Electric System. Meanwhile, the information found in this paper will be a guideline for Market Participants.

articleTitle: Solution for Auction of Multiple Units for One Product in Electrical Markets
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This paper presents a proposal of an optimization model for the multiple unit auctions for a product in electric markets, the maximization in the area between the curves, their cases of multiple solutions and the determination of the proposed allocation and block proportionality.

articleTitle: Low cost system for real-time monitoring of electrical parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a system to monitor the energy quality using ATmega2560 microcontroller embedded in the Arduino MEGA board. The proposed system is capable of acquiring voltage and current signals at sampling rate of up to 22 kHz simultaneously, and through digital processing obtains the basic parameters of the electrical signal. The samples obtained are possible to send, at various transmission rates, through the USB port to the computer. The components used in the realization are of low cost compared with the existing equipment at commercial level. The reliability of the system is validated by comparing the results with electrical metrology equipment. Keywords-- Real-time Monitoring, Open Source microcontroller, Basic electrical parameters measurements

articleTitle: Optimization model for the 2017 mid-term auction and market price
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: The paper is composed by two parts. In the first one we introduced a new notation for the optimization model of the short-term auctions of the Mexican wholesale electricity market. It was derived assuming that every interconnected system has just one capacity zone. In the second part of the paper, the market price for different sets of offers and bids is obtained.

articleTitle: "Designing a controller for balancing a robotic structure"
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This article presents the design of a fuzzy controller for the balance of a robotic structure (inverted pendulum system). The methodology uses the fundamental concepts of fuzzy logic for the design of the controller of the Mamdani type, which is implemented on the non-linear model of the system and different perturbations are applied in order to evaluate the capabilities of the controller. It's simulated to obtain the behavior of the system with Matlab / Simulink. The fuzzy algorithm is recorded in the ATMega 328 microcontroller using the EFLL library, and it's implemented in the robotic structure so that it operates by switching the control signals depending on the region of operation and to verify its robustness and efficiency, perturbations are applied in the control signal. Finally the tests are carried out in the structure and the responses to different disturbances are shown.

articleTitle: Evolution of the Capacity Market in the Wholesale Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: The Capacity Market is called as Power Balance Market (MBP for its initials in spanish) in Mexico, this market takes part of the Wholesale Electricity Market, the commercialized product in this market is Power by buying it, which generates the income to pay power plant fixed costs. The adequate payment of these costs is essential for the continuous operation of existing power electric plants and to attract investment. One of this market objectives is to ease Power transactions between the Wholesale Electricity Market Participants in order for them to accomplish established Power requirements by Comisión Reguladora de Energía (CRE for ints initials in spanish) and at the same time to sell Power that is not engaged in Electric Coverage Contracts. The MBP is designed to compute prices that reflects the Power value, in available power function and the additional income to the variable power electric plants costs paid by short term market. Establishing a Power price that reflects the installed electric capacity foments competitive generating innovation because the Market will pay the same price to each Generator that provides Power in a given region and attracts Generators whose operate with lower costs. MBP was first executed in Mexico on 28th February in 2017 with more than MX $ 54,000 millions liquidated in one day and corresponding to approximate 42,000 MW of available capacity of the 2016 production year. At 28th February in 2018 the MBP corresponding to the 2017 production year was executed which first registered Bilateral Power Transactions (TBPot for its initials in spanish) that decreased the Power to be sold in this market more than 80 %.

articleTitle: Synthesis of ZnO Nanostructured Surface: The Photocatalytic Activity, Hydrophobic Properties and the Promising Use in Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: In this work, ZnO nanonanostructures were growth by promoting the heterogeneous nucleation of a zinc (Zn) foil (99.99%) by thermal oxidation at 450 °C in air (21 wt. % oxygen) for 5 h. The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images showed that ZnO leaves-like nanostructures were achieved; the hydrophobic properties in surface and photocatalytic activity were measured; the applications of this material in the industry are discussed.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-logic Control of a Two Wheeled Inverted Pendulum
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: In this paper the implementation of a proportional Fuzzy Logic Control FLC-P, and proportional Derivative Fuzzy Logic Control FLC-PD systems in a mobile robot based in inverter pendulum on two wheeled is presented, the aim is to keep the pendulum stable to maintain the vertical, while the robot moves autonomously. The microcontroller dynamically calculates the speed values that must be delivered to the motors, depending on the measurements that are obtained from the sensors. Finally, the results obtained from the performance of the controllers are shown.

articleTitle: DC/DC converter for a PV system operating in stand-alone and grid-tied modes
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This article presents the modeling of a DC-DC Boost type converter in the Discontinuous Conduction Mode (DCM); as well as the design of its control loops, following the Average Current Control scheme (ACC). The Boost converter is part of a system that emulates photovoltaic generation by means of solar panels in the context of microgrids. The objective is to use the Boost converter to raise and regulate the voltage generated by the panels, so that it serves as an input to a single-phase full-bridge inverter, for its subsequent connection to the electricity grid, or for its operation in Standalone mode feeding a load. The designed controllers are validated by means of computer simulation, verifying that they fulfill the requirements of maximum overshoot and settling time. The results obtained prove that the designed controllers have an acceptable transient response to disturbances in the system input.

articleTitle: Procedure for the Representation of an Exempt Power Plant by a Provider of Qualified Services in the Wholesale Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: This paper presents the procedure to interconnect an exempt power plant (power plants that are smaller than 0.5 MW in net capacity) to participate in the wholesale electricity market represented by a provider of qualified services. This procedure has been developed based on the coordination of the main entities that regulate and operate the wholesale electricity market to overcome the shortcomings of the recently implemented legislation that regulates the electric industry. A series of activities and procedures were proposed based on interpretation of the applicable legislation by the different areas of the National Center of Energy Control (CENACE, acronym based on the name in Spanish). These procedures were consulted with other departments that could be affected, feedback was considered in a participatory approach until a final procedure was developed. The final procedure was informed to the provider of qualified services to facilitate the registration and clearance of the power plant. This procedure aims to serve as a proposal to improve the “Manual of Interconnection of Power Plants of Less Than 0.5 MW in Capacity", in accordance to the third transitory article that allows to modify its own dispositions based on the proposals of CENACE coordinated with the energy distributor and ratified by the Energy Regulation Commission (CRE, by its initials in Spanish)

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Risk of Geomagnetic Induced Currents (GIC's) in Power Transformers of the National Electrical System
publicationTitle: 2018 XXXI INTERNATIONAL SUMMER MEETING ON POWER AND INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS (RVP-AI)
abstract: Solar activity presents a potential risk of causing damage to different technological sectors such as communications and electrical networks. A total or partial collapse of an electrical network by an extreme solar storm would bring catastrophic consequences to the daily chores of our society. Power transformers connected in strategic locations of an interconnected electrical system such as that of the Mexican Republic, are at risk of suffering permanent damage due to geomagnetically induced currents caused by an extreme solar storm or cumulative damage along many years. The present work indicates the risk of the strategic power transformers connected to the national electricity grid in the face of a severe solar storm event and the need to develop a contingency plan in Mexico in face of the latent threat of this natural phenomenon.
